description: NEMED is a Python package for retrieving and processing historical emissions of Australia's National Electricity Market. It derives regional total and marginal emissions from Australian Energy Market Operator dispatch datasets at five-minute intervals or user-selected aggregations. Users choose a date range and region; outputs include tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent and emissions intensity per megawatt-hour. Geographic coverage is the participating NEM regions in Australia. The README documents package use and upstream data provenance, and GitHub metadata states BSD-3-Clause licensing. A limitation is that calculated marginal emissions depend on the package method and historical dispatch, so they should not be used as a forecast of a future grid without modelling changes. NEMED can calibrate generation-emission scenarios for electricity infrastructure. The related catalogue ENTSO-E transparency platform covers European electricity, not Australian NEM emissions. No AEMO files or package were downloaded.
